$comment: Group D: development scenes (docs/superpowers/plans/2026-11-13-dyno-dev-harness.md, section 3). Each names a gallery example (examples/index.ts), its parameters and how it settles; the example host page (example.html) runs it from the frozen build, on 2.0 only. Public content only: each lists the public catalog's datasets its example streams, so the licensing rule still applies (not the viewer's own defaults, which every example loads). Private ones go in a private manifest's exampleScenes (BENCH_MANIFEST). They are kept out of headline means, the Overview and budgets, and out of runs that don't name them (--scenes).

exampleScenes.title: Vertical exaggeration ×4, the valley
exampleScenes.description: The α study's wide view: Zermatt's valley from the north, terrain and OSM Buildings drawn four times as tall. Sweep param.x and view.lodExponent.

exampleScenes.title: Vertical exaggeration ×4, Zermatt close
exampleScenes.description: Close over Zermatt, where terrain is at the data's finest level and only OSM Buildings change with α.

exampleScenes.title: Vertical exaggeration ×10, Zermatt close
exampleScenes.description: The cliff-band study's view: ×10 close over Zermatt with shadows on. The crop frames the cliffs.

exampleScenes.title: Vertical exaggeration ×10, tile skirts shown
exampleScenes.description: An image check: debug=skirts at ×10 draws skirts magenta, so a crack that shows them is a regression.

exampleScenes.title: Translucency: moments and exact, split
exampleScenes.description: Glass panes from nearly clear to nearly opaque under both translucency methods. It streams no content of its own (the viewer still loads its defaults: Bing's endpoint, city lights, the Moon), so it settles without terrain or tilesets.
